Name: Em's Town Bus
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A new seasonal bus for Pam and an optional ticket bus stop sign!
Available for Content Patcher
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] and all map recolours

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/hP0sMdRT/Busstop.png[/img]

The ticket machine for the bus is a bus stop sign with a small bird
If you would rather keep the old machine, you can disable this part

Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Town Bus mod folder
Replace "true" with "false"
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Town Bus CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!
